title: vLLM - UCM Connector (CI)
description: UCM observability dashboard - connector module. Part of a set; the other UCM dashboards (tag: ucm) are linked from the header. CI variant: fixed datasource uid 'prometheus', `job` selector at the top to switch between CI environments.

panels.description: Hit rates of ucm lookup requests

targets.expr:
sum by (model_name${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:interval_lookup_hit_rates_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (model_name${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:interval_lookup_hit_rates_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connector Interval Lookup Hit Rates

panels.description: How many start_load_kv calls have data to load, per second. Always defined when loads are happening; no 0/0 NaN gaps.
panels.title: Connector Load Requests Rate

panels.description: How many wait_for_save calls have data to save, per second.
panels.title: Connector Save Requests Rate
Connector Load Requests Size Distribution
panels.description: p50 / p90 / p99 / avg number of requests per start_load_kv batch. Quiet windows naturally show no data.

targets.expr:
sum by (model_name${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:load_requests_num_sum{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (model_name${perWorker:raw}) (rate(ucm:load_requests_num_count{model_name="$model_name", job="$job"}[$__rate_interval]))
